scale: Original editorial prime-career ratings; not licensed or scraped video-game data. Career tiers measure historical stature, independent of attributes.

playerProfiles.name: Arjen Robben
playerProfiles.career: Bayern's decade-defining inverted winger; eight Bundesliga titles and the decisive 2013 Champions League final winner against Dortmund. One of the great signature-move specialists.
playerProfiles.whyTier: World-class individual peak, decisive European final, sustained club dominance and a globally influential attacking template.
playerProfiles.whyFolklore: STREET HERO for his notorious right-wing cut inside and curled left-foot finish; TALISMAN for defining Bayern's modern identity alongside Ribéry, not merely one trophy.
playerProfiles.playstyle: Demand the ball on the right, feint outside, cut inside onto left foot; create an extreme shooting threat when his defender gives one meter of space.
playerProfiles.strength: One-on-one acceleration, tight angled dribbles, curled shots, clutch composure.
playerProfiles.counter: Force onto the right foot, double up at entry to central channel and deny shooting lanes.

playerProfiles.name: Franck Ribéry
playerProfiles.career: Bayern's creative left-side focal point and key 2013 treble performer; UEFA Best Player in Europe in 2013.
playerProfiles.whyTier: Transformative decade-long club importance, extraordinary wide creativity and the highest continental club achievements.
playerProfiles.whyFolklore: STREET HERO for impossible feints and short-space dribbling; TALISMAN for shaping Bayern's identity over a long successful era.
playerProfiles.playstyle: Repeated lateral carries, hidden reverse passes and tight dribbling combinations; designed to draw multiple defenders before releasing teammates.
playerProfiles.strength: Elite dribbling, first touch, passing vision, off-balance delivery.
playerProfiles.counter: Do not dive into 1v1 challenges; layer covering defenders and remove the return passing option.

playerProfiles.name: Gerd Müller
playerProfiles.career: 365 Bundesliga goals, seven Bundesliga scoring crowns, Ballon d'Or 1970, World Cup 1974 decisive finisher and multiple European Cups with Bayern.
playerProfiles.whyTier: Foundational all-time goal-scoring standard; a clear TITAN without needing high dribbling or pace.
playerProfiles.whyFolklore: TALISMAN as a foundational Bayern club symbol; no automatic STREET HERO merely for great finishing.
playerProfiles.playstyle: Near-post movements, rapid close-range redirections, striking from awkward body positions. Maximum penalty-area conversion, limited ball-carrying.
playerProfiles.strength: Unmatched penalty-area movement, first-time finishing, ruthless positioning.
playerProfiles.counter: Deny service and crowd his six-yard channels; force him to build play from deep.

playerProfiles.name: Thomas Müller
playerProfiles.career: Bayern record appearances, 13 Bundesliga titles, two Champions League titles and the 2014 World Cup; world-class longevity as a space interpreter.
playerProfiles.whyTier: Exceptional domestic and international legacy alongside an era-defining off-ball attacking style.
playerProfiles.whyFolklore: TALISMAN for an extremely long Bayern association; not STREET HERO since his defining genius is movement more than street-skill spectacle.
playerProfiles.playstyle: Without possessing the ball, find the space nobody watches, then finish or immediately slip a teammate into a better opening.
playerProfiles.strength: Space occupation, anticipation, selfless final passes, stamina and pressing triggers.
playerProfiles.counter: Track his blindside movements and deny third-man combinations; do not merely mark where he stood a moment ago.

playerProfiles.name: Marco Reus
playerProfiles.career: Dortmund-born creator and finisher, 12 years at BVB, 170 goals and 131 assists in 429 competitive appearances according to Bundesliga's retrospective; multiple domestic cups and major individual recognition.
playerProfiles.whyTier: World-class German attacking star and enduring club symbol; injuries and fewer major team titles keep him below the strict TITAN tier.
playerProfiles.whyFolklore: STREET HERO for lightning footwork, incisive combinations and distinctive modern attacking style; TALISMAN for returning to hometown Dortmund and becoming a defining captain and symbol.
playerProfiles.playstyle: Accelerate into a vacated half-space, strike before the defensive shape settles, or ghost in behind after a teammate carries the ball.
playerProfiles.strength: Agility, acceleration, first touch, precision finishing and fast combinations.
playerProfiles.counter: Force deeper central receives and physically block runs through the inside channel.

playerProfiles.name: Stefan Effenberg
playerProfiles.career: Bayern's uncompromising captain, Bundesliga champion three consecutive seasons from 1998/99, a leader of the 2001 Champions League winning team and a decisive penalty scorer in the final.
playerProfiles.whyTier: Sustained top-class midfield authority and European-cup captaincy, without the historical universality demanded of TITAN.
playerProfiles.whyFolklore: STREET VILLAIN for a lasting confrontational, provocative on-pitch persona; no TALISMAN because Bayern has more singular defining lifetime figures.
playerProfiles.playstyle: Dictate game rhythm with assertive long passing, physically challenge midfield runners, and set an imposing tempo in possession.
playerProfiles.strength: Range of passing, long-range striking, physical authority, tactical rhythm.
playerProfiles.counter: Exploit his turning radius, bait aggressive steps out of position and force quick one-touch exchanges.

playerProfiles.name: Edin Džeko
playerProfiles.career: 26 Bundesliga goals in Wolfsburg's 2008/09 first title, Bundesliga scoring crown in 2009/10, two English Premier League titles with Manchester City and major later contributions in Italy.
playerProfiles.whyTier: Exceptionally long, international top-flight striker career with sustained goals and decisive championships; LEGEND rather than TITAN.
playerProfiles.whyFolklore: UNDERDOG as one of the decisive scorers in Wolfsburg's genuinely unforeseen 2009 Bundesliga championship. No STREET HERO simply for prolific goals.
playerProfiles.playstyle: Tall target striker with surprisingly clean technical feet, strong lay-offs and heavy first-time finishing; moves intelligently rather than sprinting past defenders.
playerProfiles.strength: Two-footed shooting, hold-up, finishing, box positioning, aerial strength.
playerProfiles.counter: Keep him away from shooting range, stop crosses/lay-offs and force repeated wide-area chases.

playerProfiles.name: Grafite
playerProfiles.career: Bundesliga 2008/09 Golden Boot with 28 goals in 25 matches, Wolfsburg's first Bundesliga title, extraordinary weaving dribble and backheel goal against Bayern.
playerProfiles.whyTier: One historic brilliant peak with impressive career but not enough long-term world-class influence for the strict LEGEND category.
playerProfiles.whyFolklore: STREET HERO for the legendary self-made goal against Bayern; UNDERDOG for a decisive season in Wolfsburg's shock title.
playerProfiles.playstyle: Strong striker who can unexpectedly dribble through tight central crowds then finish from an improbable angle.
playerProfiles.strength: Sudden dribble improvisation, short explosive runs, instinctive finishes and shielding.
playerProfiles.counter: Never assume he is a static target; deny his diagonal feet and crowd him before he enters the box.

playerProfiles.name: Diego Ribas
playerProfiles.career: Werder Bremen's creative star, top assist provider in the Bundesliga in 2006/07 and 2007/08, key in Werder's 2009 DFB-Pokal triumph and UEFA Cup final run.
playerProfiles.whyTier: Brilliant and memorable German peak with significant longevity elsewhere, but not enough sustained world-historical greatness for LEGEND.
playerProfiles.whyFolklore: STREET HERO because feints, outrageous technical actions and set-piece artistry made him a cult Bundesliga magician; no strict club TALISMAN despite being beloved at Werder.
playerProfiles.playstyle: Classic No.10 who dribbles into midfield pressure, draws defenders, then finds a threaded release or drives a shot from the edge of the box.
playerProfiles.strength: Tight-space ball mastery, incisive final ball, finesse shooting and invention.
playerProfiles.counter: Maintain two defensive layers and block central passing lanes; do not chase his first feint.

playerProfiles.name: Zvjezdan Misimović
playerProfiles.career: The chance-creation center of Wolfsburg's 2008/09 Bundesliga champions, supplying 20 league assists and seven goals.
playerProfiles.whyTier: An outstanding Bundesliga creative peak with valuable club and international career, but not consistent global legend stature.
playerProfiles.whyFolklore: UNDERDOG for indispensably organizing Wolfsburg's unexpected first title. No STREET HERO because the defining genius was systematic creation rather than showboating.
playerProfiles.playstyle: Seek one or two touches to find advanced strikers, manipulate passing angles, and split compact defenses without sprinting or dribbling excessively.
playerProfiles.strength: Final-ball timing, field vision, disguise, set-piece service and controlled tempo.
playerProfiles.counter: Screen the supply channels to runners and force him to beat people with pace rather than passes.
